department: Machine Learning PhD (interdisciplinary; nine home schools)

deadline.value: Deadlines follow the home school: the earliest is 1 December, most close 15 December (the School of Computer Science home unit closes 15 December 2026). Fall entry only.
deadline.quote: The application deadline varies by home school with the earliest deadline of December 1. Most home schools have a final deadline of December 15.

also.quote: Machine Learning (School of Computer Science) Computer Science Computing Atlanta Doctoral Fall 2026 Fall 2027 12/15/2025 12/15/2026

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies; requirements follow the home school.

supervisor.value: The ML PhD page does not say whether a supervisor's agreement is needed before applying.

funding.value: Funding, including any teaching-assistantship or fellowship guarantee, is set by the home school you apply through.
funding.quote: support for incoming students (including guarantees of teaching assistantships and/or fellowships) are determined by the home units

entry_route.value: Applicants are judged on a B.S. or M.S. record, so you can apply from a bachelor's or a master's.
entry_route.quote: prior academic performance of the applicant in a B.S. or M.S. program at a recognized institution

notes: You apply through one home school (e.g., Computer Science, CSE, Interactive Computing, ECE, ISyE, Mathematics, ChBE, BME, Aerospace) and must meet its GPA, GRE and TOEFL rules; the ML faculty committee makes the final decision.
name: PhD in Machine Learning
